categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Yunlu Advanced Materials Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the design, R&D, production, and sales of advanced magnetic metal materials, including amorphous alloys, nanocrystalline alloys, and magnetic powders and their products. The main product lines are amorphous alloy thin strips and cores, nanocrystalline ultra-thin strips, atomized and crushed powders, and magnetic powder cores. These products are primarily applied in power distribution, new energy vehicles, 5G infrastructure, rail transit, data centers, consumer electronics, home appliances, and heavy ion scientific research.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as small-flow melt precision continuous casting, extreme condensation control, high-temperature electromagnetic oxidation metallurgy, and extreme cooling atomization. These enable the production of high-quality amorphous and nanocrystalline alloy thin strips with precise thickness and width control. The company also developed industrialized amorphous three-dimensional wound cores and automated production lines, enhancing product performance and manufacturing efficiency. R&D is supported by collaborations with top universities and research institutes, focusing on material composition design, process innovation, and application expansion.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include power grid companies, electrical equipment manufacturers, and producers of amorphous cores, transformers, and electronic devices. The company serves domestic and international markets, with products sold to over 30 countries including India, South Korea, and Vietnam. End markets span power distribution, new energy vehicles, photovoltaic inverters, rail transit, data centers, consumer electronics, and home appliances. Major clients include State Grid Corporation of China, AUX, Toshiba Japan, ABB, Tesla, Gree, and TDK.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Qingdao, Shandong Province. It has expanded its international footprint with sales in over 30 countries across Southeast Asia, South Asia, and North America. It has established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Shenzhen to enhance R&D and customer responsiveness. The overseas markets notably include India, South Korea, Vietnam, the United States, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunlu Materials operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the magnetic materials supply chain. It produces raw and semi-finished advanced magnetic metal materials such as amorphous and nanocrystalline alloy strips and magnetic powders. The company is extending downstream by supplying finished products like amorphous cores and integrated solutions for transformers and magnetic components, moving towards a full-industry-chain comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in advanced soft magnetic materials, focusing on expanding product applications across wide frequency bands and multiple industry sectors. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 19.17% increase in expenditure in 2024, and maintains over 190 active patents globally. Strategic R&D projects include high saturation magnetic induction amorphous materials, magnetic powder core industrialization, new soft magnetic powder development, and high-performance nanocrystalline strips for new energy and photovoltaic sectors. The company aims to deepen integration of science, engineering, and design to accelerate disruptive technology breakthroughs and expand global patent portfolios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of advanced magnetic metal materials and related products, including amorphous alloy thin strips, nanocrystalline strips, magnetic powders, and finished magnetic cores. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales contracts with industrial customers, including long-term framework agreements and spot orders. Pricing is cost-plus based, considering raw material costs, production expenses, taxes, and market competition. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yunlu Materials is a leading domestic player and the largest supplier of amorphous alloy thin strips in China, with a designed annual capacity of 105,000 tons. It holds a dominant market share in the domestic magnetic materials industry and is expanding rapidly internationally. The company is recognized as a national-level technology center and a specialized 'Little Giant' enterprise. It competes with other advanced magnetic material producers globally by leveraging its full-industry-chain capabilities, advanced manufacturing technologies, and broad application coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.9 billion, representing a 7.24% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 361 million, up 8.73% from the previous year. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of RMB 3.14 billion and shareholders' equity of RMB 2.5 billion, both showing double-digit growth. R&D investment accounted for 5.99% of revenue, reflecting a growth trend in innovation spending. The company has a stable cash dividend policy, distributing over 30% of net profits to shareholders consistently.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunlu Materials emphasizes its advanced manufacturing technologies that produce high-performance, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly soft magnetic materials with superior properties such as low coercivity, high magnetic permeability, and high electrical resistivity. Its amorphous alloys offer significant energy savings over traditional silicon steel, contributing to carbon reduction and green energy initiatives. The company provides full lifecycle green solutions, including manufacturing, usage, and recycling, and offers integrated product and system solutions tailored to customer needs. Its global patent portfolio and collaboration with top research institutions further differentiate its technological leadership.
